scripts.all: concurrently -n laravel,vite -c "#fb923c,#a1a1aa" "php artisan serve --port=8054" "npm run dev"
scripts.all:host: concurrently -n laravel,vite -c "#fb923c,#a1a1aa" "php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8054" "npm run dev -- --host"
scripts.all:ngrok: npm run build && concurrently -n laravel,ngrok -c "#fb923c,#38bdf8" "php artisan serve --port=8054" "ngrok http 8054"
